name: anurag-portfolio
description: npm install     cp .env.example .env     # then fill in EmailJS keys     npm run dev              # http://localhost:5173     npm run build            # output in dist/ ## Edit content Everything (links, services, projects, skills) is in `src/data/content.js`. Leave a link as '' to hide its button. ## Contact form (EmailJS, free tier) 1. Sign up at emailjs.com, add an Email Service (Gmail) -> copy Service ID. 2. Create a template using variables {{name}}, {{email}}, {{service}}, {{budget}}, {{message}}; set "To" to your email -> copy Template ID. 3. Account > API keys -> copy Public Key. 4. Put the 3 values in `.env`. In Vercel/Netlify, add the same 3 variables in project settings. `.env` is git-ignored. EmailJS public keys are visible in the browser by design; in EmailJS, restrict allowed domains and enable reCAPTCHA for stronger spam protection. ## Deploy     git init && git add . && git commit -m "Initial portfolio"     git branch -M main && git remote add origin https://github.com/anurag-pandey123/portfolio.git && git push -u origin main Vercel: vercel.com > Add New Project > import repo > framework Vite > add env vars > Deploy. Custom domain: Project > Settings > Domains, then add the DNS records shown. HTTPS is automatic.
